issues.legal_issue: A statutory exemption from rent-control restrictions that applies when an eviction suit is instituted within the exemption period continues to govern that suit until adjudication, even if the period expires while the suit is pending.
material_facts: The landlord filed a civil suit for possession of a rented shop while the building remained within the statutory exemption period for newly constructed buildings.
The exemption period expired while the suit was pending.
The tenant sought dismissal on the ground that the rent-control statute had become applicable after the exemption expired, and the High Court dismissed the suit for want of civil-court jurisdiction.
issues.conclusion: The exemption continued to apply to the suit because it had been instituted within the exemption period. The High Court's order was set aside, the Sub-Judge's order was restored, and the suit was to proceed in accordance with law.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 1(3) and 13(1) of the Haryana Urban (Control of Rent and Eviction) Act, 1973, read purposively, mean that a suit instituted within the ten-year exemption period is not defeated merely because the period expires during its pendency; the parties' rights crystallise when the suit is instituted, and adjudication must proceed on that basis. The Court relied on Vineet Kumar v. Mangal Sain Wadhera, Nand Kishore Marwah v. Samundri Devi, Om Prakash Gupta v. Dig. Vijendrapal Gupta, and Ram Saroop Rai v. Lilavati. It also applied the principle actus curiae neminem gravabit and the purposive approach to interpretation discussed in Poppatlal Shah v. State of Madras and Black-Clawson International Ltd. v. Papierwerke Waldhof-Aschaffenburg A.G.

predicates.civil_eviction_suit: A landlord filed a civil-court suit to recover possession of a rented building from a tenant.
predicates.exemption_unexpired_at_filing: The suit was instituted while the building remained within the period during which the rent-control restrictions did not apply to it.
predicates.exemption_expired_while_pending: The period during which the rent-control restrictions did not apply expired while the suit remained pending.

issues.definition: When a landlord's civil eviction suit is filed while the building remains exempt from rent-control restrictions and that exemption expires during the suit, the exemption continues until the suit is adjudicated.
